title: PAH-OMC-005 nonzero-Q anchor generator compatibility
question: Does the actual unchanged PAH-001 midpoint generator remain compatible with a genuine PAH-OMC-004 geometric strip refinement on a nonzero-Q common anchor cylinder?
method: Create the separately hashed researcher contract PAH-OMC-005 without modifying PAH-001 or PAH-OMC-004.
Fix the genuine square-to-two-triangle diagonal strip and the anchor interaction closure at post-boundary levels n>=1.
Define the geometric inclusion by retaining old coordinates and adding neutral zero-charge coordinates; use the pointwise anchor-aperture cylinder as the common observable lift.
Evaluate the full displayed PAH-001 functional, including onsite matter polynomial, aperture stiffness, covariant matter edges and Wilson faces, on every Q=1 patch state.
Compare the exact midpoint generator tuple between G_1 and the neutral inclusion in G_2, then independently rebuild the same rows without importing the primary implementation.

Run hostile mutations for Q=0 substitution, colour-only topology, omitted matter/face terms, fitted rates, wrong mobility, frontier leakage, charge-changing inclusion and physical promotion; cross-check the finite arithmetic in Lean.
finding: The anchor interaction closure is identical at G_1 and G_2. With K=2, M_s=M_psi=1 and Q=1, all 32768 finite patch states have identical exact rows (Delta F, mobility^2, observable increments and midpoint exponent). The primary lane passes 21/21, independent 16/16, hostile 9/9 mutations rejected, integrated 17/17 and Lean R485 compiles.
decision_reason: R-484 established the local row mechanism only on a Q=0 diagnostic. This result supplies a genuinely nonzero-charge finite state correspondence and replays the same unchanged PAH functional and rate, so it advances the geometric candidate without treating the new map as pre-existing PAH-001 structure.
evidence_level: T0 finite exact nonzero-Q generator-row replay with primary, non-importing independent, hostile, integrated and Lean verification

assumptions: PAH-001 and PAH-OMC-004 remain byte-identical at their pinned hashes.
The Q=1 fixture is a finite researcher proposal and uses the unchanged displayed couplings and midpoint rate.
The neutral inclusion adds only zero-charge remote coordinates and preserves the four-vertex anchor closure.

missing_assumptions: A total gauge-equivariant refinement map for arbitrary fine matter/link cylinders.

boundary: Finite local compatibility only. The result does not close T-054, does not change any canonical gate or claim tier, and does not establish an infinite-volume generator, uniform limit, physical sector, Pre-A, spacetime, gravity, QFT, Yang--Mills, continuum, mass gap or TOE conclusion.
next_action: Construct a new hash-pinned contract for a nontrivial matter or link cylinder and prove its boundary-root transport or record an exact obstruction; do not infer it from the anchor-aperture result.
revisit_condition: Reopen the uniform lane only when the full nonzero-Q state transport, boundary root map and common-core norm are explicitly supplied.
non_claims: No physical Pre-A, spacetime, gravity, QFT, Yang--Mills, continuum, mass-gap or TOE conclusion.
No retroactive modification or completion of PAH-001, PAH-OMC-001, PAH-OMC-003 or PAH-OMC-004.
